case_number: 2023 INSC 692; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 879 OF 2023 WITH CRIMINAL APPEAL Nos. 884, 882, 880, 881 and 883 of 2023
summary: Section 138 NI Act complaint quashing; mandatory Section 141(1) averments missing for vicarious liability against non-executive directors; statutory notice not served; directors not signatories; complaints quashed for lacking 'in charge of and responsible for conduct'; High Court failed to notice deficiencies; appeals allowed; complaints set aside in relation to appellants.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; impugned High Court judgment set aside; complaints quashed in relation to present appellants.
